info.title: Outrun API
info.description: Wildfire evacuation dispatch for residents who can't evacuate alone. Every number comes from an engine; agents call these tools and explain results.

post.summary: Add a help request to the plan
post.description: Send a structured request: the caller's address, needs, people, notes. The backend looks up the coordinates and fills in the map cell, vehicle types and loading time. If the address isn't found, the error says what to ask the caller. The person becomes visible to the planner after the call-handling delay.

post.summary: Add a report of fire at a place and time
post.description: Send a structured fire sighting: the nearest address, what was seen. The backend looks up the coordinates. It feeds the fire forecast from reported_at onward, alongside satellite detections.

get.description: Every approve, modify or reject decision recorded so far, in order.

post.summary: Record what the emergency manager did with a plan
post.description: Call only after the emergency manager explicitly says approve, modify or reject, with the plan_id from get_current_plan. Never approve on your own.

Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description: What the emergency manager did with a plan.

polygon.title: Polygon
polygon.description: Zone outline as [lon, lat] pairs (GeoJSON order)

source.title: Source
source.description: Where this time came from (URL or citation)

EvacOrder.title: EvacOrder
EvacOrder.description: A real evacuation warning or order, hand-mapped from after-action reviews.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: License type, e.g. residential care for the elderly

Facility.title: Facility
Facility.description: A real licensed care facility (California Community Care Licensing data).

observed_at.title: Observed At
observed_at.description: When the satellite looked (overpass or scan)

available_at.title: Available At
available_at.description: When the detection was published, ONLY if the source records it. Leave empty and the assumed publish delay for its satellite (backend/assumptions.py) is applied.

source.title: Source
source.description: Satellite and instrument: VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, GOES18...

pixel_m.title: Pixel M
pixel_m.description: Pixel size, metres: about 375 for VIIRS, about 2000 for GOES. The fire is somewhere inside it.

FireDetection.title: FireDetection
FireDetection.description: One satellite fire detection (NASA FIRMS VIIRS, NOAA GOES).

p_1h.title: P 1H
p_1h.description: P(fire reaches this cell within 1 hour)

arrival_p10_min.title: Arrival P10 Min
arrival_p10_min.description: Pessimistic arrival: 10% chance the fire arrives sooner than this many minutes after t. None = not expected within the forecast horizon.

FireOutlook.title: FireOutlook
FireOutlook.description: Fire forecast for one map cell at time t. Produced by the nowcast engine.

location_precision_m.title: Location Precision M
location_precision_m.description: How precisely the published record locates it

FireReport.title: FireReport
FireReport.description:
One report of fire at a place and time: a 911 call or radio report in live use; in the
Eaton replay, a timestamped report from the published investigations (FSRI, county review).
Reports were the main real-time signal that night: the VIIRS satellite's first detection of
the fire was at 1:30 a.m.

address.title: Address
address.description: Nearest street address with house number and city. The backend looks up the coordinates.

description.title: Description
description.description: What was seen, in a short sentence

reported_at.title: Reported At
reported_at.description: When it was reported. Omit to use the replay clock's current time.

lat.title: Lat
lat.description: Only if known from a device, never estimated

lon.title: Lon
lon.description: Only if known from a device, never estimated

FireReportIn.title: FireReportIn
FireReportIn.description: A fire sighting, structured by the Intake agent from a call or radio message.

address.title: Address
address.description: Street address with house number and city, as the caller said it. The backend looks up the coordinates.

needs.title: Needs
needs.description: wheelchair, oxygen, bedbound, no_car (can move but has no ride), or none

people.title: People
people.description: How many people need the ride

reported_at.title: Reported At
reported_at.description: When the call came in. Omit to use the replay clock's current time.

lat.title: Lat
lat.description: Only if known from a device, never estimated

lon.title: Lon
lon.description: Only if known from a device, never estimated

HelpRequest.title: HelpRequest
HelpRequest.description:
A structured help request. The Intake agent turns free text into this; the backend
fills in every number (coordinates, cell, vehicle types, load time).

unreachable.title: Unreachable
unreachable.description: At-risk residents no vehicle can reach in time. Escalated, never dropped.

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Plain-language reason per resident, filled in from engine numbers

escalated_fire_command.title: Escalated Fire Command
escalated_fire_command.description: Subset of unreachable: too late, or only reachable through danger. These go to fire command (from docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

Plan.title: Plan
Plan.description: Output of the route optimizer at time t.

PlanChange.title: PlanChange
PlanChange.description: One edit a human made to a plan.

h3.title: H3
h3.description: H3 res-9 cell containing the home

vehicle_types.title: Vehicle Types
vehicle_types.description: Vehicle types that can carry them

load_minutes.title: Load Minutes
load_minutes.description: Time to get them into a vehicle

Resident.title: Resident
Resident.description:
One person who may need help evacuating. Care-facility residents come from real licensed
facilities; everyone else is estimated from Census counts (real addresses are not public).

deadline_min.title: Deadline Min
deadline_min.description: Pick up within this many minutes after t. None = no deadline in horizon

at_risk.title: At Risk
at_risk.description: True = the router must route or escalate this person

ResidentRisk.title: ResidentRisk
ResidentRisk.description: Risk engine output for one resident at time t.

eta_min.title: Eta Min
eta_min.description: Minutes after t until arrival at each stop

Route.title: Route
Route.description: One vehicle's ordered stops. Stops are resident ids and shelter ids.

opened_at.title: Opened At
opened_at.description: When it opened for evacuees. None = open before the fire

source.title: Source
source.description: Citation for the location and opening time

Shelter.title: Shelter
Shelter.description: A drop-off point. Real shelters opened during the night, so each has an opening time.

Vehicle.title: Vehicle
Vehicle.description: One vehicle in the rescue fleet.

free_in_min.title: Free In Min
free_in_min.description: Minutes until it finishes its current run

stops.title: Stops
stops.description: Remaining stops in order: resident ids, then a shelter

eta_min.title: Eta Min
eta_min.description: Minutes after t until each stop

VehicleRun.title: VehicleRun
VehicleRun.description: What one vehicle is doing at time t.

picked_up.title: Picked Up
picked_up.description: Resident id -> when a vehicle left with them

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: What each vehicle is actually doing: remaining approved stops, ETAs in minutes after t

plan_takes_effect_at.title: Plan Takes Effect At
plan_takes_effect_at.description: When the plan above is approved and vehicles start following it

WorldState.title: WorldState
WorldState.description: Everything the dashboard needs at time t, in one message.
